'''Salliche''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region. It was the headquarters of the [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation]]. The planet was one of 18 planets on the [[Agricultural Circuit]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
It was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] since at least [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]]. It remained loyal to the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and gained many new agricultural contracts upon the secession of [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]].

Upon announcing his New Order, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces to Salliche to ensure that its abundant crops and efficient harvesting corporation continued to support his growing war machine. The planet's proximity to other Core Worlds, its access to easy space travel, and a worker population prone to discontent and strikes made it a hotbed for potential subversive activity against the new galactic government.

The [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation]] fully cooperated with the Empire, putting its own security forces at the disposal of Imperial military and [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB) officers. Imperial forces established a garrison in the capital, [[Netassa]], with fortified outposts at key commercial and transportation facilities. The ISB organized aggressive undercover purges to eliminate potential malcontents and future political troublemakers from the general population of disgruntled ag laborers; the resulting mass arrests necessitated a recruitment campaign to lure beleaguered workers from other systems to labor in Salliche's agricultural industries. During this time, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Gegren Throsen]] manipulated the planet's corporate and legislative bodies to inflict his own will and that of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]; however, the planet remained loyal to [[House Harbright]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

The planetary parliament elected [[Selnia Harbright]] to the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], primarily to remove the idealistic young noblewoman from Salliche's corporate and legislative hierarchy, get her off the planet, and place her in a relatively ineffective position in galactic politics. Little did they suspect that she secretly used her aristocratic influence to undermine Imperial military power on her homeworld and rid it of corporate and military tyranny by aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> 

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the collapse of centralized Imperial authority, Moff Gegren Throsen assumed direct control of the Salliche system and the Salliche Ag Corporation. The local Legislature was dissolved, and the existing bureaucracy and corporate security forces were replaced by Imperial administrators and stormtroopers. Officials who questioned Imperial rule were imprisoned in hastily constructed detention facilities near the Salliche starport.<ref name=":0">[[Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant|''Recon & Report: The Journey to Coruscant'']]</ref>

To secure the region, Throsen stationed garrisons and two Star Destroyers in each of the eighteen worlds formerly overseen by the corporation. Resistance soon erupted on [[Yulant]], [[Ruan]], and [[Broest/Legends|Broest]], where workers—supported by surviving Rebel cells—burned crops, sabotaged hydroponic installations, and carried out limited bombings of storage and processing facilities. The uprisings drew harsh reprisals from Imperial forces attempting to reassert control.<ref name=":0" />

The sudden takeover left many bureaucrats and corporate guards unemployed and resentful, fostering anti-Imperial sentiment on Salliche itself. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agents began coordinating with these disaffected groups to disrupt Imperial supply lines, ambush garrison units, and target administrative offices facilitating food exports to the Core Worlds.<ref name=":0" />

[[Huff Darklighter]] once employed farmers from Salliche, as well as [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] and [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], to staff his underground hydroponic gardens on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
